messages.en: Have you taken your medicine yet? I put it on the table earlier.
Not yet. I couldn't find it. Is it in that white bag?
Yep, in that bag. Look next to the water bottle, Nisa.
Have you finished writing your speech for tomorrow's event?
Yeah, I just want to go over it one more time tonight.
Don't forget to wish Aina a happy birthday, okay? It's her birthday today.
I remember! I'll just send her a voice message later.
